title: Chicken Teriyaki
description: A home-style chicken teriyaki recipe featuring chicken thigh, soy sauce, mirin. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Cook rice according to its package. Cut broccoli into florets and steam for 5–7 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Mix soy sauce, mirin and sugar. Pat chicken dry and heat oil in a skillet over medium heat.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Sear chicken for 6–8 minutes per side, adjusting heat to prevent scorching. Add the sauce and simmer until glossy and chicken reaches 74°C in the thickest part.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Slice chicken, spoon over the glaze and serve with rice and broccoli.

title: Miso Tofu Soup
description: A home-style miso tofu soup recipe featuring firm tofu, white miso, kombu stock. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Rehydrate wakame in water for 5 minutes, drain and chop. Dice tofu and slice spring onions.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Bring kombu stock to a gentle simmer. Add tofu and wakame and heat for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Turn off the heat. Dissolve miso in a ladleful of hot broth, stir into the pot and serve with spring onions. Do not boil after adding miso.

title: Burmese Tomato Chickpea Salad
description: A home-style burmese tomato chickpea salad recipe featuring tomato, chickpeas, shallot. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Slice tomatoes and shallots thinly. Rinse and drain chickpeas thoroughly.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Crush peanuts coarsely and chop coriander.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Whisk lime juice, sesame oil and salt. Toss with tomatoes, shallots and chickpeas.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Fold in peanuts and coriander just before serving.

title: Burmese Coconut Chicken Noodles
description: A home-style burmese coconut chicken noodles recipe featuring chicken thigh, egg noodles, coconut milk. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Dice chicken and onion. Mince garlic and ginger; whisk chickpea flour into 100 ml of the stock.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Soften onion in oil for 5 minutes, then stir in garlic, ginger and turmeric for 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add chicken, remaining stock and coconut milk. Simmer for 20 minutes, then whisk in the flour mixture and cook for 5 minutes, until chicken reaches 74°C.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Cook noodles separately and drain. Season soup with fish sauce, divide over noodles and serve with lime wedges.

title: Thai Basil Chicken
description: A home-style thai basil chicken recipe featuring ground chicken, Thai basil, garlic. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Cook rice following the packet. Chop garlic and chilli; cut beans into 2 cm pieces.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Heat oil in a wok, fry garlic and chilli for 30 seconds, then add chicken and break it apart.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add beans and stir-fry for 6–8 minutes until chicken reaches 74°C. Stir in sauces and sugar and cook for 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Turn off heat, fold in basil until wilted and serve over rice.

title: Thai Red Tofu Curry
description: A home-style thai red tofu curry recipe featuring firm tofu, vegan red curry paste, coconut milk. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Cook rice. Cube tofu and cut pepper and courgette into bite-size pieces.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Heat oil and fry curry paste for 1 minute. Stir in coconut milk and stock.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add tofu and vegetables and simmer gently for 12–15 minutes until vegetables are tender.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Add soy sauce and sugar, fold in basil and serve with rice.

title: Singapore Chicken Rice
description: A home-style singapore chicken rice recipe featuring chicken thigh, rice, ginger. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Place chicken, half the ginger, spring onions, salt and water in a pot. Simmer gently for 25–30 minutes until chicken reaches 74°C. Reserve the broth.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Rinse rice. Fry minced garlic and remaining ginger in sesame oil for 1 minute, add rice, then 500 ml reserved broth or the amount recommended on the rice packet.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Cover and simmer rice for 15 minutes or until absorbed, then rest covered for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Slice chicken and cucumber. Serve with rice, soy sauce and a small bowl of reheated broth.

title: Singapore Style Prawn Laksa
description: A home-style singapore style prawn laksa recipe featuring raw peeled prawns, rice noodles, laksa paste. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Prepare rice noodles according to their packet and drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Fry laksa paste in oil for 2 minutes. Add coconut milk and stock and simmer for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add tofu puffs and prawns; simmer for 3–5 minutes until prawns are opaque throughout. Add sprouts and cook for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Season with fish sauce, ladle over noodles and serve with lime wedges.

title: Nasi Lemak with Egg
description: A home-style nasi lemak with egg recipe featuring rice, coconut milk, water. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Rinse rice and place in a pot with coconut milk, water, tied pandan leaf and salt.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Bring to a simmer, cover and cook on low for 15–18 minutes until absorbed. Rest covered for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Meanwhile boil eggs for 10 minutes, cool and peel. Slice cucumber.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Remove pandan and serve rice with halved eggs, cucumber, peanuts and sambal.

title: Malaysian Chicken Satay
description: A home-style malaysian chicken satay recipe featuring chicken thigh, turmeric, ground coriander. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Cut chicken into strips. Mix turmeric, coriander, soy sauce, sugar and oil; coat chicken and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Soak wooden skewers in water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Thread chicken onto skewers. Grill over medium-high heat for 10–15 minutes, turning often, until the thickest pieces reach 74°C.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: In a separate pan, warm peanut butter, coconut milk and finely chopped chilli for 3 minutes, stirring. Finish with lime juice.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Serve satay with the warm peanut sauce.

title: Vietnamese Lemongrass Chicken
description: A home-style vietnamese lemongrass chicken recipe featuring chicken thigh, lemongrass, garlic. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Finely mince the tender inner lemongrass and garlic. Mix with fish sauce, sugar and oil; coat chicken and refrigerate for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Cook rice according to its packet and slice cucumber.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Grill or pan-fry chicken over medium heat for 7–10 minutes per side until the thickest part reaches 74°C.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Slice and serve with rice, cucumber and lime wedges.

title: Vietnamese Tofu Rice Paper Rolls
description: A home-style vietnamese tofu rice paper rolls recipe featuring firm tofu, rice paper, rice vermicelli. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Cook vermicelli as directed and cool under water. Slice tofu into strips and pan-fry in oil for 8 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Julienne carrot and cucumber, and wash lettuce and mint.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Soften one rice paper sheet in warm water. Add lettuce, noodles, tofu, vegetables and mint; fold in sides and roll tightly. Repeat.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Mix soy sauce and lime juice for dipping and serve promptly.

title: Nasi Goreng
description: A home-style nasi goreng recipe featuring cooked rice, egg, kecap manis. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Chop shallots, garlic, carrot and spring onions. Break up cold rice.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Heat half the oil and fry eggs until whites and yolks are set; transfer to plates.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add remaining oil, shallots, garlic and carrot. Stir-fry for 3 minutes, then add rice and kecap manis. Fry until rice is steaming hot throughout.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Fold in spring onions and serve immediately with eggs and sliced cucumber. Reheat rice only once.

title: Tempeh Kecap Stir Fry
description: A home-style tempeh kecap stir fry recipe featuring tempeh, kecap manis, soy sauce. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Cook rice. Slice tempeh thinly, trim beans and chop shallots, garlic and chilli.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Pan-fry tempeh in oil for 6–8 minutes until golden, then remove.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Cook shallots, garlic and chilli for 2 minutes. Add beans and water, cover and steam for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Return tempeh, add both sauces and toss for 2 minutes. Serve with rice.

title: Chicken Adobo
description: A home-style chicken adobo recipe featuring chicken thigh, soy sauce, cane vinegar. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Cook rice separately. Crush garlic and pat chicken dry.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Brown chicken in oil for 3 minutes per side. Add soy sauce, vinegar, water, garlic, bay and peppercorns.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Bring to a simmer and cook uncovered for 5 minutes, then cover and simmer gently for 25 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Uncover and reduce sauce for 10 minutes until chicken reaches 74°C. Remove bay leaves and serve with rice.

title: Filipino Garlic Fried Rice
description: A home-style filipino garlic fried rice recipe featuring cooked rice, garlic, vegetable oil. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Finely chop garlic and spring onions. Break up cold rice.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Fry garlic gently in oil until pale golden. Reserve half for garnish.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add rice and salt and stir-fry until steaming hot throughout. In a separate nonstick pan, fry eggs until whites and yolks are set.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Serve rice with eggs, spring onions and reserved garlic. Reheat rice only once.

title: Beef Bulgogi Bowls
description: A home-style beef bulgogi bowls recipe featuring beef sirloin, soy sauce, pear. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Grate pear and garlic; mix with soy sauce, sesame oil and sugar. Marinate beef in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Cook rice. Thinly slice onion and carrot.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Heat a large skillet and stir-fry onion and carrot for 3 minutes. Add beef in batches with marinade and cook thoroughly, bringing the marinade to a bubbling simmer.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Serve over rice with sesame seeds.

title: Kimchi Tofu Stew
description: A home-style kimchi tofu stew recipe featuring firm tofu, vegan kimchi, vegetable stock. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Cook rice. Slice onion, cube tofu and chop kimchi and garlic.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Heat sesame oil and cook onion for 4 minutes. Add garlic, kimchi and gochujang and stir for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add stock and soy sauce and simmer for 10 minutes. Add tofu and simmer for another 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Top with sliced spring onion and serve with rice.

title: Tomato Egg Stir Fry
description: A home-style tomato egg stir fry recipe featuring egg, tomato, spring onion. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Cook rice separately. Beat eggs with half the salt and cut tomatoes into wedges.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Heat half the oil and softly scramble eggs until just set; transfer to a plate.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Heat remaining oil, add tomatoes, sugar and remaining salt and cook for 5–7 minutes until juicy.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Return eggs and heat until fully set and piping hot. Add chopped spring onions and serve with rice.

title: Ginger Mushroom Noodles
description: A home-style ginger mushroom noodles recipe featuring wheat noodles, shiitake mushrooms, bok choy. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Cook noodles according to their packet and drain. Slice mushrooms, ginger and garlic; separate bok choy leaves.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Heat vegetable oil and stir-fry mushrooms for 5 minutes. Add ginger and garlic for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add bok choy and water, cover for 2 minutes, then uncover.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Toss in noodles, soy sauce and sesame oil. Stir-fry for 2 minutes and serve hot.

title: Chana Masala
description: A home-style chana masala recipe featuring chickpeas, tomato, onion. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Cook rice. Chop onion and mince garlic and ginger.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Soften onion in oil for 8 minutes, then add garlic, ginger and spices and stir for 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add tomatoes, chickpeas, water and salt. Simmer uncovered for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Lightly mash a few chickpeas to thicken the sauce and serve with rice.

title: Spinach Paneer Curry
description: A home-style spinach paneer curry recipe featuring paneer, spinach, onion. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Blanch spinach in boiling water for 1 minute, drain and blend with 100 ml water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Chop onion and tomatoes, mince garlic and ginger and cube paneer.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Soften onion in oil for 6 minutes, add garlic, ginger and cumin for 1 minute, then tomatoes and salt for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Add spinach and paneer and simmer gently for 5 minutes. Stir in cream and garam masala and heat through.

title: Nepalese Dal Bhat
description: A home-style nepalese dal bhat recipe featuring red lentils, rice, onion. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Rinse lentils and simmer with water and turmeric for 20–25 minutes until soft. Cook rice separately.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Chop onion, tomatoes, garlic and ginger.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Heat oil and sizzle cumin for 30 seconds. Add onion and cook for 5 minutes, then garlic, ginger and tomato for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Stir the seasoning into lentils, add salt and simmer for 5 minutes. Serve alongside rice.

title: Nepalese Potato Sesame Salad
description: A home-style nepalese potato sesame salad recipe featuring potato, sesame seeds, lemon juice. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Boil potatoes in water for 15–20 minutes until tender, drain and cut into chunks.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Dry-toast sesame seeds until golden and grind coarsely.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Warm mustard oil in a small pan, add turmeric and finely chopped chilli and cook for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Toss potatoes with sesame, spiced oil, lemon juice, salt and chopped coriander. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Cottage Pie
description: A home-style cottage pie recipe featuring ground beef, potato, onion. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Heat oven to 200°C. Peel and cube potatoes and boil until tender, about 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Soften chopped onion and carrots in oil for 6 minutes. Add beef and brown thoroughly, then add tomato paste, stock and Worcestershire sauce.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Simmer for 20 minutes, add peas and transfer to a baking dish. Mash drained potatoes with butter, milk and salt.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Spread mash over filling and bake for 25 minutes until golden and the filling is bubbling hot.

title: Leek Potato Soup
description: A home-style leek potato soup recipe featuring leek, potato, vegetable stock. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Split leeks, rinse between their layers and slice. Peel and dice potatoes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Melt butter and soften leeks over medium-low heat for 8 minutes without browning.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add potatoes and stock and simmer for 20 minutes until tender.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Blend carefully, stir in milk, salt and pepper, and gently reheat without a vigorous boil.

title: Ratatouille
description: A home-style ratatouille recipe featuring aubergine, courgette, bell pepper. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Dice aubergine, courgettes, peppers and tomatoes; chop onion and garlic.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Brown aubergine in half the oil for 8 minutes and remove. Add remaining oil and soften onion and peppers for 7 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add garlic, courgettes, tomatoes, thyme, salt and aubergine. Cover and simmer gently for 25 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Uncover and cook for 5 minutes to reduce excess liquid, then fold in torn basil.

title: French Lentil Vegetable Stew
description: A home-style french lentil vegetable stew recipe featuring green lentils, carrot, celery. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Rinse lentils and dice carrot, celery and onion.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Cook diced vegetables in olive oil for 8 minutes, then stir in minced garlic for 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add lentils, tomato, stock, thyme and bay. Simmer partially covered for 30–35 minutes until lentils are tender.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Remove bay and stir in Dijon mustard. Add a splash of water if needed for a stew consistency.

title: German Warm Potato Salad
description: A home-style german warm potato salad recipe featuring potato, onion, vegetable stock. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Boil whole potatoes for 20–25 minutes until tender, drain and peel when cool enough to handle.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Finely chop onion and simmer it in stock for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Whisk vinegar, mustard, oil, salt and pepper into the warm stock.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Slice potatoes and gently toss with the dressing. Stand for 10 minutes and scatter with chopped chives.

title: German Cabbage Apple Skillet
description: A home-style german cabbage apple skillet recipe featuring red cabbage, apple, onion. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Shred cabbage, thinly slice onion and core and dice apples.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Melt butter and cook onion for 5 minutes. Add cabbage and apples and stir for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add vinegar, apple juice, sugar, caraway and salt. Cover and cook gently for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Uncover and cook for 5 minutes until excess liquid evaporates and cabbage is tender.

title: Spaghetti Pomodoro
description: A home-style spaghetti pomodoro recipe featuring spaghetti, tomato, garlic. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Gently warm sliced garlic in olive oil for 1 minute without browning.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Add tomatoes, half the salt and pepper, crush with a spoon and simmer for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Cook spaghetti in water seasoned with the remaining salt according to its packet. Reserve 150 ml pasta water and drain.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Toss pasta with sauce and torn basil, adding a little reserved water until glossy.

title: Mushroom Risotto
description: A home-style mushroom risotto recipe featuring arborio rice, mushroom, onion. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Keep stock hot in a saucepan. Slice mushrooms and finely chop onion and garlic.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Brown mushrooms in olive oil for 7 minutes and set aside. Soften onion in half the butter for 5 minutes, add garlic and rice and stir for 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add hot stock one ladle at a time, stirring and letting each addition absorb, for 18–22 minutes until rice is tender with a slight bite.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Fold in mushrooms, remaining butter, grated cheese, pepper and chopped parsley. Serve immediately.

title: Spanish Potato Tortilla
description: A home-style spanish potato tortilla recipe featuring potato, egg, onion. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Peel and thinly slice potatoes and onion. Gently cook in oil in an ovenproof 24 cm skillet for 18–20 minutes until tender, stirring carefully.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Drain excess oil into a heatproof bowl. Beat eggs with salt and pepper and fold in potatoes and onions.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Return mixture to the lightly oiled skillet and cook on low heat for 6–8 minutes until edges set.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Finish under a medium grill for 4–6 minutes until the centre is fully set. Rest for 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Smoky Chickpea Spinach Skillet
description: A home-style smoky chickpea spinach skillet recipe featuring chickpeas, spinach, tomato. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Slice garlic and rinse chickpeas.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Warm garlic in olive oil for 1 minute. Add paprika and cumin and stir for 20 seconds.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add tomatoes, chickpeas and salt and simmer for 12 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Fold in spinach until wilted, simmer for 3 minutes and finish with sherry vinegar.

title: Dutch Kale Stamppot
description: A home-style dutch kale stamppot recipe featuring potato, kale, milk. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Peel and cube potatoes. Remove tough kale stalks and finely shred leaves.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Place potatoes in a large pot, cover with water and boil for 15 minutes. Add kale and boil for another 5–8 minutes until potatoes are tender.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Drain well and return to the warm pot for 1 minute to dry.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Mash together with warm milk, butter, mustard, salt and pepper. Serve hot.

title: Dutch Apple Pancakes
description: A home-style dutch apple pancakes recipe featuring plain flour, milk, egg. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Whisk flour, milk, eggs and salt into a smooth batter. Core apples and slice very thinly.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Mix cinnamon and sugar. Heat a little butter in a nonstick skillet.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Arrange a few apple slices in the pan, pour over a thin layer of batter and cook for 2–3 minutes until the top begins to set.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Flip carefully and cook for another 1–2 minutes. Repeat with remaining batter and serve sprinkled with cinnamon sugar.

title: Swiss Potato Rosti
description: A home-style swiss potato rosti recipe featuring potato, butter, vegetable oil. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Peel and coarsely grate potatoes. Squeeze firmly in a clean towel to remove moisture.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Toss with salt and pepper. Heat half the butter and oil in a nonstick 24 cm skillet.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Press potatoes into an even layer and cook over medium-low heat for 10–12 minutes until deeply golden underneath.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Slide onto a plate, invert back into the pan with remaining butter, and cook for 10–12 minutes until golden and tender throughout.

title: Swiss Inspired Alpine Macaroni
description: A home-style swiss inspired alpine macaroni recipe featuring macaroni, potato, onion. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Peel potatoes and cut into 1 cm cubes. Thinly slice onions.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Cook onions slowly in butter for 20 minutes, stirring until golden.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Boil potatoes for 5 minutes, add macaroni and cook until both are tender according to the pasta packet. Drain.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Heat milk and cream gently, stir in grated cheese, salt and pepper, then fold in pasta and potatoes. Top with onions.

title: Swedish Meatballs
description: A home-style swedish meatballs recipe featuring ground beef, ground pork, breadcrumbs. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Soak breadcrumbs in 100 ml milk. Finely grate onion and mix with beef, pork, egg, soaked crumbs, allspice, salt and pepper. Form 24 small meatballs.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Brown meatballs in half the butter in batches, then remove.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Melt remaining butter, stir in flour for 1 minute and gradually whisk in stock, remaining milk and cream.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Return meatballs and simmer for 12–15 minutes until their centres reach 71°C and gravy thickens.

title: Swedish Dill Potato Salad
description: A home-style swedish dill potato salad recipe featuring potato, Greek yogurt, sour cream. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Boil potatoes for 20–25 minutes until tender. Drain and let cool, then cut into chunks.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Whisk yogurt, sour cream, mustard, lemon juice, salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Thinly slice radishes and chop dill.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Fold potatoes, radishes and dill into the dressing. Chill until serving.

title: Classic Beef Burgers
description: A home-style classic beef burgers recipe featuring ground beef, burger bun, cheddar. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Divide beef into four patties and season with salt and pepper. Slice tomato and onion.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Grill or pan-fry patties over medium-high heat for 5–7 minutes per side until centres reach 71°C.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add cheese during the final minute and lightly toast buns.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Layer buns with lettuce, tomato, burgers, onion and ketchup and serve immediately.

title: Baked Mac and Cheese
description: A home-style baked mac and cheese recipe featuring macaroni, cheddar, milk. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Heat oven to 200°C. Cook macaroni for 2 minutes less than its packet time and drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Melt butter, stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in milk and simmer until thickened.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Stir in mustard, salt, pepper and 200 g grated cheese, then fold in macaroni.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Transfer to a baking dish, scatter with remaining cheese and breadcrumbs and bake for 20 minutes until bubbling and golden.

title: Maple Mustard Salmon
description: A home-style maple mustard salmon recipe featuring salmon fillet, maple syrup, Dijon mustard. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Heat oven to 200°C. Mix maple syrup, mustard and soy sauce.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Place salmon on a lined baking tray and brush with glaze.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Toss beans with oil, arrange around salmon and roast for 12–18 minutes until salmon reaches 63°C and beans are tender.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Serve with lemon wedges and the cooked pan juices.

title: Canadian Style Split Pea Soup
description: A home-style canadian style split pea soup recipe featuring yellow split peas, carrot, celery. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Rinse split peas. Dice onion, carrot and celery.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Soften vegetables in olive oil for 8 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add peas, stock, thyme and bay. Bring to a boil, then simmer partially covered for 60–70 minutes until peas are very soft, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Remove bay, add pepper and lightly mash to thicken. Add water if needed.

title: Black Bean Tacos
description: A home-style black bean tacos recipe featuring black beans, corn tortilla, onion. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Finely chop onion and garlic. Dice tomatoes and avocado and chop coriander.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Cook half the onion in oil for 4 minutes, add garlic and spices for 30 seconds, then beans, water and salt.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Simmer for 8 minutes and lightly mash. Warm tortillas in a dry skillet.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Fill with beans, tomato, avocado, remaining onion and coriander. Serve with lime wedges.

title: Chicken Tomato Tinga
description: A home-style chicken tomato tinga recipe featuring chicken breast, onion, tomato. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Poach chicken in stock for 15–20 minutes until it reaches 74°C. Reserve 150 ml stock and shred chicken.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Slice onions and soften in oil for 8 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Blend tomatoes, chipotle, garlic and reserved stock. Add to onions and simmer for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Fold in shredded chicken and heat thoroughly. Serve in warmed tortillas with sliced avocado.

title: Gallo Pinto
description: A home-style gallo pinto recipe featuring cooked rice, black beans, onion. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Dice onion and pepper and mince garlic.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Soften onion and pepper in oil for 5 minutes, then add garlic for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add beans, water and Salsa Lizano and simmer for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Stir in rice and cook until steaming hot throughout. Fold in coriander and serve immediately. Reheat rice only once.

title: Costa Rican Picadillo de Papa
description: A home-style costa rican picadillo de papa recipe featuring potato, ground beef, onion. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Peel potatoes and cut into 1 cm cubes. Chop onion, pepper, garlic and tomatoes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Soften onion and pepper in oil for 5 minutes, add beef and brown thoroughly.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add garlic, annatto and tomatoes for 2 minutes. Stir in potatoes, stock and salt.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until potatoes are tender and beef is cooked through. Uncover to reduce excess liquid and finish with coriander.

title: Cuban Black Beans
description: A home-style cuban black beans recipe featuring black beans, onion, green bell pepper. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Cook rice separately. Finely dice onion and pepper and mince garlic.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Soften onion and pepper in oil for 7 minutes; add garlic, cumin and oregano for 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add beans, stock and bay. Simmer for 25 minutes, mashing some beans against the pot.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Remove bay, stir in vinegar and serve with rice.

title: Cuban Mojo Chicken
description: A home-style cuban mojo chicken recipe featuring chicken thigh, orange juice, lime juice. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Mix juices, crushed garlic, oil, cumin, oregano and salt. Coat chicken and refrigerate for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Heat oven to 210°C. Slice onion and place in a roasting dish.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Arrange chicken over onion and pour over marinade.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Roast for 40–45 minutes until chicken reaches 74°C and juices bubble. Rest for 5 minutes and spoon over cooked pan juices.

title: Brazilian Black Bean Pork Stew
description: A home-style brazilian black bean pork stew recipe featuring pork shoulder, black beans, smoked sausage. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Brown pork in oil in a heavy pot for 8 minutes. Add chopped onion and sliced sausage and cook for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Add minced garlic, bay leaves, water and salt. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes until pork is tender.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add beans and simmer for 15 minutes, lightly mashing some to thicken.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Remove bay leaves and serve with peeled orange slices.

title: Brazilian Cheese Bread
description: A home-style brazilian cheese bread recipe featuring tapioca starch, milk, vegetable oil. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Heat oven to 200°C and line a baking tray. Bring milk, oil and salt just to a boil.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Pour over tapioca starch and stir firmly. Let cool for 10 minutes until warm rather than hot.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Mix in egg and finely grated cheese until a sticky dough forms. With lightly oiled hands form 20 small balls.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Bake spaced apart for 20–25 minutes until puffed and lightly golden. Serve warm.

title: Argentinian Beef Empanadas
description: A home-style argentinian beef empanadas recipe featuring ground beef, onion, red bell pepper. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Soften chopped onion and pepper in oil for 6 minutes. Add beef, cumin, paprika and salt and cook thoroughly. Cool the filling.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Fold in chopped olives and hard-boiled eggs. Heat oven to 200°C.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Place a spoonful of filling on each pastry disc, moisten edges with water, fold and crimp tightly.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Brush with beaten egg and bake on a lined tray for 20–25 minutes until golden and filling is piping hot.

title: Chimichurri Roasted Vegetables
description: A home-style chimichurri roasted vegetables recipe featuring potato, carrot, courgette. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Heat oven to 220°C. Cut potatoes and carrots into small chunks and courgettes into thick slices.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Toss potatoes and carrots with 2 tbsp oil and half the salt; roast for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add courgettes, toss and roast for another 20 minutes until tender.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Finely chop parsley and garlic, mix with remaining oil and salt, vinegar, oregano and chilli, and spoon over roasted vegetables.

title: Chilean Corn Beef Casserole
description: A home-style chilean corn beef casserole recipe featuring ground beef, sweetcorn, onion. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Heat oven to 200°C. Soften chopped onion in half the butter for 6 minutes, add beef, cumin, paprika and half the salt and cook thoroughly.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Blend sweetcorn with milk to a coarse puree. Cook in remaining butter with remaining salt for 8 minutes, stirring until thick.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Spread beef in a baking dish and top with sliced eggs and olives. Cover with corn mixture.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Bake for 25 minutes until the top is golden and filling bubbles.

title: Chilean Tomato Onion Salad
description: A home-style chilean tomato onion salad recipe featuring tomato, onion, coriander leaves. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Thinly slice onion and soak in cold water for 10 minutes, then drain well.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Slice tomatoes and chop coriander.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Whisk oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Gently toss all ingredients and serve fresh.

title: Colombian Cheese Arepas
description: A home-style colombian cheese arepas recipe featuring precooked white cornmeal, warm water, mozzarella. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Mix cornmeal, warm water, softened butter and salt. Rest for 5 minutes, then knead into a soft dough.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Fold in grated mozzarella and divide into eight balls. Flatten into discs about 1.5 cm thick.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Lightly oil a skillet and cook arepas over medium-low heat for 7–9 minutes per side.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Serve when golden outside and cooked through with no wet dough in the centre.

title: Colombian Hogao Eggs
description: A home-style colombian hogao eggs recipe featuring egg, tomato, spring onion. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Finely chop tomatoes, spring onions and garlic.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Cook spring onions in oil for 3 minutes. Add garlic, tomatoes, cumin, salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Simmer for 10 minutes until thickened. Make eight shallow wells and crack in eggs.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Cover and cook gently for 6–8 minutes until whites and yolks are set.

title: Lomo Saltado
description: A home-style lomo saltado recipe featuring beef sirloin, potato, red onion. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Heat oven to 220°C. Cut potatoes into fries, toss with 1 tbsp oil and roast for 25–30 minutes. Cook rice separately.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Slice beef into strips, onion into wedges and tomatoes into thick wedges; mince garlic.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Stir-fry beef in remaining oil over high heat in batches until cooked to preference; remove. Fry onion and garlic for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Return beef with tomatoes, soy sauce and vinegar; toss for 2 minutes. Fold in fries and coriander and serve with rice.

title: Peruvian Inspired Quinoa Vegetable Soup
description: A home-style peruvian inspired quinoa vegetable soup recipe featuring quinoa, potato, carrot. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Rinse quinoa well. Dice potatoes, carrots and onion and mince garlic.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Soften onion in oil for 5 minutes, then add garlic and cumin for 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add stock, quinoa, potatoes and carrots and simmer for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Add sweetcorn for 5 minutes, check that quinoa and potatoes are tender, then stir in chopped coriander.

title: Egyptian Koshari
description: A home-style egyptian koshari recipe featuring rice, brown lentils, macaroni. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Simmer lentils in water for 25–30 minutes until tender and drain. Cook rice and macaroni separately according to their packets.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Thinly slice onions and fry slowly in 3 tbsp oil for 15–20 minutes until deep golden.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: In another pan fry minced garlic and cumin in remaining oil, add tomatoes, vinegar and salt, and simmer for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Warm chickpeas, layer with rice, lentils and macaroni, then spoon over tomato sauce and fried onions.

title: Ful Medames
description: A home-style ful medames recipe featuring fava beans, garlic, ground cumin. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Place beans, water, minced garlic and cumin in a saucepan and simmer for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Mash about half the beans with a fork to thicken.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Stir in lemon juice, 2 tbsp oil and salt and warm for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Top with diced tomatoes, chopped parsley and remaining oil.

title: Moroccan Chickpea Vegetable Tagine
description: A home-style moroccan chickpea vegetable tagine recipe featuring chickpeas, carrot, courgette. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Dice onion and cut carrots and courgettes into chunky pieces. Halve apricots.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Soften onion in oil for 5 minutes, then stir in cumin, cinnamon and ginger.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add carrots, tomatoes, stock, apricots and salt and simmer covered for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Add chickpeas and courgettes and simmer for 15 minutes until vegetables are tender and sauce thickens.

title: Moroccan Couscous Salad
description: A home-style moroccan couscous salad recipe featuring couscous, vegetable stock, chickpeas. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Bring stock to a boil, pour over couscous and raisins, cover and stand for 5 minutes or follow packet directions.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Fluff couscous with a fork and let cool slightly.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Dice cucumber and tomatoes, chop parsley and rinse chickpeas.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Whisk lemon juice, oil and cumin and toss with all ingredients.

title: Sukuma Wiki
description: A home-style sukuma wiki recipe featuring collard greens, onion, tomato. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Remove thick stalks from greens, wash well and shred finely. Chop onion and tomatoes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Soften onion in oil for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add tomatoes and salt and cook for 5 minutes until softened.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Add greens and water, cover and cook for 8–10 minutes until tender, stirring once or twice.

title: Kenyan Coconut Bean Stew
description: A home-style kenyan coconut bean stew recipe featuring red kidney beans, coconut milk, tomato. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Cook rice separately. Chop onion and tomatoes and mince garlic.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Soften onion in oil for 5 minutes, add garlic and spices for 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes. Stir in beans, coconut milk, water and salt.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, and serve with rice.

title: Vegetable Jollof Rice
description: A home-style vegetable jollof rice recipe featuring long grain rice, tomato, red bell pepper. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Blend tomatoes, pepper, half the onion and garlic. Dice remaining onion and carrot and rinse rice.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Soften diced onion in oil for 5 minutes, add tomato paste for 2 minutes, then blended sauce and cook down for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add rice, stock, thyme, curry powder, bay and carrot. Cover tightly and simmer on low for 20 minutes, checking liquid if needed.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Add peas, cover and cook for 5 minutes, then rest off heat for 10 minutes. Remove bay and fluff.

title: Nigerian Inspired Yam Tomato Stew
description: A home-style nigerian inspired yam tomato stew recipe featuring yam, tomato, red bell pepper. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Cut yam into 3 cm chunks and rinse. Blend tomato and pepper and chop onion.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Soften onion in palm oil for 4 minutes, add blended sauce and ginger and simmer for 8 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add yam, stock and salt, cover and simmer for 20–25 minutes until yam is fully tender.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Mash a few yam pieces into the sauce and fold in spinach for 2 minutes.

title: South African Bobotie
description: A home-style south african bobotie recipe featuring ground beef, onion, white bread. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Heat oven to 180°C. Soak bread in 150 ml milk. Soften chopped onion in oil for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Add beef and curry powder and brown thoroughly. Stir in soaked bread, chutney, raisins and salt.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Spread into a baking dish. Whisk eggs with remaining milk and pour over the beef. Place bay leaves on top.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Bake for 30–35 minutes until custard is set and the centre is piping hot. Remove bay leaves before serving.

title: Chakalaka
description: A home-style chakalaka recipe featuring baked beans, onion, carrot. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Chop onion and peppers, grate carrots and mince garlic and ginger.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Soften onion in oil for 5 minutes, add peppers for 5 minutes, then garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add carrots, tomatoes and salt and simmer for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Stir in baked beans and simmer for 5 minutes until piping hot.

title: Australian Beef Meat Pies
description: A home-style australian beef meat pies recipe featuring ground beef, onion, beef stock. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Soften chopped onion in oil, add beef and brown thoroughly. Stir in tomato paste, stock and Worcestershire sauce and simmer for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Mix cornflour with water, stir into beef and simmer until thick. Let filling cool until no longer steaming.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Heat oven to 200°C. Line four individual pie tins with shortcrust pastry and add filling. Top with puff pastry, seal edges and cut a steam vent.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Brush with beaten egg and bake for 30–35 minutes until golden and hot throughout.

title: Pumpkin Feta Spinach Salad
description: A home-style pumpkin feta spinach salad recipe featuring pumpkin, baby spinach, feta. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Heat oven to 210°C. Cube pumpkin and toss with 1 tbsp oil, salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Roast for 25–30 minutes until tender and caramelised, then cool slightly.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Whisk remaining oil with vinegar and honey.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Arrange spinach and pumpkin, crumble over feta and add seeds. Drizzle with dressing.

title: Rosemary Lamb Chops
description: A home-style rosemary lamb chops recipe featuring lamb loin chops, garlic, rosemary. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Cut potatoes into small cubes and boil for 12–15 minutes until tender; drain.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Mix minced garlic, chopped rosemary, oil, lemon zest, salt and pepper and rub over lamb.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Grill or pan-fry lamb over medium-high heat for 4–6 minutes per side, until it reaches at least 63°C; rest for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Toss warm potatoes in the cooked pan juices and serve with lamb and lemon wedges.

title: Kiwi Fruit Yogurt Parfaits
description: A home-style kiwi fruit yogurt parfaits recipe featuring kiwi fruit, Greek yogurt, rolled oats. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Peel kiwifruit and cut into small pieces.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Roughly chop almonds and mix with oats.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Layer yogurt, kiwifruit and oat mixture in four glasses.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Drizzle with honey and serve immediately, or refrigerate and add oats just before serving.

title: Fijian Inspired Coconut Fish
description: A home-style fijian inspired coconut fish recipe featuring white fish fillet, coconut milk, tomato. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Cook rice separately. Chop onion, garlic and tomatoes and cut fish into large pieces.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Soften onion in oil for 5 minutes, add garlic and tomatoes and cook for 4 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add coconut milk and salt and simmer for 5 minutes. Add fish and simmer gently for 6–8 minutes until fish reaches 63°C.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Fold in spinach until wilted, turn off heat and add lime juice. Serve with rice.

title: Fijian Style Cassava Coconut Bake
description: A home-style fijian style cassava coconut bake recipe featuring cassava, light coconut milk, sugar. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Thaw cassava and remove any woody core. Boil in plenty of fresh water for 20 minutes until tender; discard all cooking water.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Heat oven to 180°C and butter a baking dish. Mash cooked cassava while warm.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Mix in coconut milk, sugar, vanilla and salt. Spread into the dish.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Bake for 40–45 minutes until set with a golden top. Cool before slicing. Use food-grade prepared cassava, never bitter cassava.

title: Papua New Guinea Inspired Coconut Chicken
description: A home-style papua new guinea inspired coconut chicken recipe featuring chicken thigh, sweet potato, coconut milk. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Peel sweet potatoes and cut into chunks. Cut chicken into large pieces, slice ginger and chop spring onions.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Place coconut milk, water, ginger and spring onions in a pot and bring to a gentle simmer.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add chicken and sweet potatoes. Cover and simmer for 25–30 minutes until sweet potatoes are tender and chicken reaches 74°C.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Stir in spinach and salt and simmer for 3 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Coconut Sweet Potato Mash
description: A home-style coconut sweet potato mash recipe featuring sweet potato, coconut milk, ginger. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Peel sweet potatoes, cut into even chunks and boil in water for 18–20 minutes until tender.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Drain thoroughly and return to the warm pot for 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Warm coconut milk with finely grated ginger, then mash into the sweet potatoes with salt.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Scatter with thinly sliced spring onions and serve warm.

title: Chicken Karahi
description: A home-style chicken karahi recipe featuring chicken thigh, tomato, ginger. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Cut chicken into pieces, chop tomatoes, mince garlic and half the ginger, and finely slice remaining ginger.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Heat oil in a wide pan and brown chicken for 6 minutes. Add minced ginger and garlic for 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add tomatoes, cumin, coriander and salt. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until chicken reaches 74°C.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Uncover, add chillies and garam masala and reduce sauce for 5–8 minutes. Finish with sliced ginger and coriander leaves.

title: Aloo Palak
description: A home-style aloo palak recipe featuring potato, spinach, onion. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Peel and cube potatoes, chop onion and tomatoes, and mince garlic and ginger.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Soften onion in oil for 5 minutes, add garlic, ginger, cumin and turmeric for 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add tomatoes, potatoes, water and salt. Cover and simmer for 18–20 minutes until potatoes are tender.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Fold in chopped spinach and cook uncovered for 5 minutes until wilted and excess liquid has reduced.

title: Bangladeshi Masoor Dal
description: A home-style bangladeshi masoor dal recipe featuring red lentils, water, onion. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Rinse lentils and simmer with water and turmeric for 20–25 minutes until soft.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Slice onion and garlic and slit chilli.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Heat mustard oil, add cumin seeds for 30 seconds, then onion for 6 minutes and garlic and chilli for 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Stir the seasoned oil into lentils with salt, simmer for 3 minutes and finish with coriander.

title: Bangladeshi Mustard Fish Curry
description: A home-style bangladeshi mustard fish curry recipe featuring white fish fillet, yellow mustard seeds, coconut milk. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Soak mustard seeds in warm water for 15 minutes, drain and blend with 150 ml fresh water. Cook rice separately.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Cut fish into large pieces and rub with half the turmeric and salt.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Heat oil in a wide pan, add mustard paste, coconut milk, chillies and remaining turmeric and salt; simmer for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Add fish and simmer gently for 8–12 minutes until it reaches 63°C. Serve with rice.

title: Sri Lankan Coconut Dhal
description: A home-style sri lankan coconut dhal recipe featuring red lentils, coconut milk, water. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Rinse lentils and place in a pot with water, turmeric and sliced chilli. Simmer for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Add coconut milk and salt and cook gently for 10 minutes until creamy.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: In a small pan heat oil and pop mustard seeds. Add sliced onion, garlic and curry leaves and fry until onion is golden.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Stir the fragrant oil into the dhal and serve hot.

title: Sri Lankan Coconut Roti
description: A home-style sri lankan coconut roti recipe featuring plain flour, desiccated coconut, warm water. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Mix flour, coconut and salt with finely chopped onion and chilli.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Add warm water gradually to form a soft dough; knead for 2 minutes and rest for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Divide into eight balls and flatten into discs about 5 mm thick using lightly oiled hands.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Cook in a lightly oiled skillet over medium heat for 3–4 minutes per side until golden spots appear and centres are cooked.

title: Lebanese Mujadara
description: A home-style lebanese mujadara recipe featuring brown lentils, long grain rice, onion. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Thinly slice onions and cook slowly in oil for 25–30 minutes until deep golden, stirring often.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Meanwhile simmer lentils in 1 litre water for 15 minutes, then drain, reserving cooking liquid.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Combine lentils, rinsed rice, cumin, salt, half the onions and 500 ml reserved cooking liquid. Cover and simmer on low for 15–20 minutes until rice is tender.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Rest covered for 10 minutes and top with remaining onions.

title: Lebanese Tabbouleh
description: A home-style lebanese tabbouleh recipe featuring fine bulgur, boiling water, parsley. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Cover fine bulgur with boiling water and stand for 15 minutes; drain any excess thoroughly.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Wash and dry parsley and mint, then chop very finely.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Finely dice tomatoes and slice spring onions.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Toss bulgur, herbs and vegetables with lemon juice, olive oil and salt. Serve fresh.

title: Iranian Adas Polo
description: A home-style iranian adas polo recipe featuring basmati rice, brown lentils, onion. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Simmer lentils in a separate pot of water for 20 minutes until almost tender and drain. Rinse rice.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Thinly slice onion and fry in 2 tbsp oil for 10 minutes. Add turmeric, cinnamon, raisins and chopped dates for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Combine rice, lentils, water, salt and remaining oil in a pot. Bring to a simmer, cover and cook on low for 15–20 minutes until water is absorbed.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Rest covered for 10 minutes, fluff and top with onion and fruit mixture.

title: Iranian Shirazi Salad
description: A home-style iranian shirazi salad recipe featuring cucumber, tomato, red onion. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Dice cucumbers, tomatoes and red onion into small even pieces.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Whisk lime juice, olive oil, dried mint, salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Toss vegetables with the dressing.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Rest for 10 minutes before serving so the flavours mingle.

title: Greek Lemon Chicken Potatoes
description: A home-style greek lemon chicken potatoes recipe featuring chicken thigh, potato, lemon juice. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Heat oven to 210°C. Peel potatoes and cut into wedges.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Mix lemon juice, oil, crushed garlic, oregano, salt and pepper. Coat chicken and potatoes and arrange in a roasting dish.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Pour stock around the sides and roast for 45–55 minutes, turning potatoes halfway.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Check chicken reaches 74°C and potatoes are tender; rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Greek Chickpea Salad
description: A home-style greek chickpea salad recipe featuring chickpeas, cucumber, tomato. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Rinse and drain chickpeas. Chop cucumber and tomatoes and thinly slice onion.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Whisk olive oil, lemon juice and oregano.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Toss chickpeas, vegetables and olives with dressing.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Crumble feta over the top and serve.

title: Portuguese Caldo Verde
description: A home-style portuguese caldo verde recipe featuring potato, kale, onion. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Peel and dice potatoes, chop onion and garlic, and shred kale very finely.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Soften onion in oil for 5 minutes, add garlic for 1 minute, then potatoes and stock. Simmer for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Blend the soup base carefully until smooth.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Add thinly sliced sausage and kale, simmer for 8–10 minutes until sausage is cooked and kale is tender, then add pepper.

title: Portuguese Tomato Rice
description: A home-style portuguese tomato rice recipe featuring long grain rice, tomato, onion. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Chop onion, garlic and tomatoes and rinse rice.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Soften onion in oil for 5 minutes. Add garlic and tomatoes and cook for 7 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Stir in rice, stock, bay and salt. Simmer partially covered for 15–18 minutes until rice is tender but still saucy.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Remove bay, stir in parsley and serve immediately. Add hot water if it becomes too thick.

title: Irish Beef Stew
description: A home-style irish beef stew recipe featuring beef chuck, potato, carrot. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Cut beef into 3 cm cubes and toss with flour, salt and pepper. Brown in oil in batches.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Add chopped onion and tomato paste and cook for 4 minutes. Return beef with stock, thyme and bay.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Cover and simmer gently for 75 minutes, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Add chunky potatoes and carrots and simmer for 35–45 minutes until beef is tender and vegetables are cooked. Remove bay before serving.

title: Irish Colcannon
description: A home-style irish colcannon recipe featuring potato, cabbage, spring onion. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Peel and cube potatoes and boil for 20 minutes until tender.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Shred cabbage and cook in half the butter with 3 tbsp water for 8–10 minutes until soft.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Warm milk with sliced spring onions. Drain potatoes and mash with milk, remaining butter, salt and pepper.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Fold in cabbage and serve hot.

title: Polish Potato Cheese Pierogi
description: A home-style polish potato cheese pierogi recipe featuring plain flour, warm water, egg. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Mix flour, egg, warm water and half the salt into a smooth dough; knead for 5 minutes and rest covered for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Boil peeled potatoes until tender and mash. Soften chopped onion in half the butter. Mix potatoes, quark, half the onion, pepper and remaining salt and cool.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Roll dough thinly, cut 8 cm circles, fill with a teaspoon of filling and pinch edges tightly closed.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Boil in batches until floating, then for 3 more minutes. Drain and toss with remaining butter and onion.

title: Polish Mushroom Barley Soup
description: A home-style polish mushroom barley soup recipe featuring pearl barley, mushroom, carrot. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Rinse barley, dice onion, carrots and potatoes, and slice mushrooms.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Soften onion in butter for 5 minutes, add mushrooms and cook for 7 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add barley, carrots, stock and bay and simmer for 20 minutes. Add potatoes and simmer for 15–20 minutes until barley and potatoes are tender.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Remove bay and stir in chopped dill and pepper.

title: Jamaican Jerk Style Chicken
description: A home-style jamaican jerk style chicken recipe featuring chicken thigh, spring onion, garlic. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Blend spring onions, garlic, ginger, chilli, allspice, thyme, sugar, soy sauce, lime juice and oil into a paste. Handle chilli carefully and wash hands afterward.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Coat chicken and marinate covered in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Heat oven to 210°C. Arrange chicken in a lined roasting dish.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Roast for 40–45 minutes until nicely browned and the thickest part reaches 74°C. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Jamaican Rice and Peas
description: A home-style jamaican rice and peas recipe featuring long grain rice, red kidney beans, coconut milk. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Rinse rice. Combine coconut milk, water, beans, chopped spring onions, crushed garlic, thyme, allspice and salt in a pot.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Bring to a simmer, add rice and the whole uncut chilli and stir once.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Cover tightly and cook on low for 18–20 minutes until liquid is absorbed, adding a little water if necessary.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Rest covered for 10 minutes, carefully remove the chilli without breaking it and fluff the rice.

title: Ethiopian Misir Wat
description: A home-style ethiopian misir wat recipe featuring red lentils, onion, garlic. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Finely chop onions and cook gently in oil for 12 minutes, stirring often.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Add minced garlic and ginger, berbere and tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Rinse lentils and add with water. Simmer gently for 25–30 minutes until soft and thick, stirring frequently.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Add salt and a splash of hot water if needed. Serve as a thick stew.

title: Ethiopian Cabbage Potato Carrot Skillet
description: A home-style ethiopian cabbage potato carrot skillet recipe featuring cabbage, potato, carrot. Designed for 4 servings with practical, approachable steps.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Slice cabbage and onion, cut potatoes into small cubes and carrots into thin rounds. Mince garlic and ginger.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Soften onion in oil for 6 minutes, add garlic, ginger, turmeric and cumin for 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add potatoes, carrots, water and salt, cover and cook for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Fold in cabbage, cover and cook for 12–15 minutes until all vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally.
